verdict.rationale: Claude Cowork's built-in browser lets Claude open sites, read pages, click, type, and fill forms to complete tasks, and computer-use mode lets it navigate the screen directly; the Chrome extension additionally lets it test, verify, and debug in-browser with console/network/DOM access — together these directly support autonomous web research and task completion. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community validation of browser-driving reliability and any documented limits (e.g. accuracy, speed, failure cases) beyond first-party docs.
